dataList.content:
Ah... There it is.
啊……就是那里。
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles's Deck
梅菲斯托费勒斯 甲板

dataList.content:
Our destination, the Lobotomy Corp. Branch of U Corp.
我们的目的地，U公司的脑叶公司支部。

You think they're still there...? The survivors Pilot mentioned?
你们觉得……皮利托先生所说的幸存者们……还会在这里吗？

... Unless aught has transpired since then, we still have time aplenty.
……若那之后无事发生的话，有充裕时间留予他们生存。

As Sinclair and Yi Sang shared their thoughts, the large structure loomed ever closer, out of the mist and into our line of sight.
在辛克莱和李箱谈论着的同时，被雾气笼罩的巨大建筑物逐渐显露了身形，闯入了我们的视野之中……

Ho. Creepy.
呵。真怪。

Every Sinner, save for Ryōshū, froze.
除了良秀外，罪人们的表情一瞬间都僵住了。

That's... the Lobotomy Corp. Branch...?
所以……那就是脑叶公司支部吗？

We are as close as it is physically possible to be to the center of the area delineated by the coordinates. The structure's size and appearance match the intel we received as well.
我们现已物理意义上无限接近坐标范围的中央。该建筑的大小和外形也与我们所收到的信息一致。

Ah... Ahh...
啊……啊啊……

The sight was enough to shut everyone up.
那幅景象足以令所有人失语……

To hope that there may be any survivors in this structure was far too optimistic a notion for what appeared before us.
令我们再难以说出“幸存者”这个过分乐观的词语。

I observe the Lobotomy Corp. logo between the white materials.
观测到处于白色物质之间的脑叶公司徽标。

So that's... really...
所以……那真的是……

Only the smeared logo of the Lobotomy Corp. Branch glistened amidst mounds of pallid, blasphemous white. This was the undeniable reality we found ourselves in.
唯有那模糊闪烁于一大片苍白之中的脑叶公司徽标在告诉着我们，这就是我们所在的，无可否认的现实。

What the hell happened here...?
那里到底发生了什么才会变成那样……？

Pilot said that the last thing that the Twinhook Pirates said before leaving this place was...
据皮利托先生所说，双钩海盗们在离开这里之前的最后一句话是……

'The Calamity is coming', wasn't it?
“灾难就要来了”……是这个吧？

This sight summons to my mind memories from the earlier days of this company. The manner in which the organic tissues are... plastered over the walls is quite reminiscent of that experience.
我还记得刚开始在公司工作的日子。那种……有机组织黏附在墙上的方式让人想起那段经历。

Eugh... Back at the D Corp. Branch, right? I hope there's no poison gas trap or anything like that in here...
呃……D公司支部？里面应该没有以前那样的毒气了吧……？

At D Corp., there was a traitor in our midst. Thus, it would be false equivalency to use that experience to gauge the intensity of this mission.
在D公司那时，我们之中有一个叛徒。因此并不适合用来和现况作比较。

Yeah, I... don't think it'll be much better here... if not worse.
那情况……我认为情况只会更糟，就算更好也肯定好不到哪去……

Then... Pilot's team is already...
然后……皮利托先生的同事已经……

We should consider them lucky if they haven't been turned into Mermaids...
如果他们没有变成人鱼就好了……那多么幸运。

<So the Calamity was...>
<所以灾难是……>

The Calamity that Pilot mentioned didn't destroy the Lobotomy Corp. Branch.
皮利托所说的灾难似乎并非破坏支部。

It transformed this place into something uncanny. Something so grotesque that total obliteration would've been preferable to whatever happened here.
而是……要把它变成另一种东西，一种令人不快的、怪诞的东西，不如说是毁灭更好。

Well, destruction isn't the only kind of calamity in this world.
嗯，世上的灾难千奇百怪，毁灭不是唯一一种。

The Great Lake is home to five Calamities. Well... four now, I suppose.
大湖共有五个灾难。啊，现在只剩四个了。

Whatever do you mean?
这到底是什么意思？

I meant that... Hm. You'll find out soon enough.
意思就是……嗯，你很快便会明白。

It won't matter how careful you are. At the Great Lake, the Calamities will always find you. The laws of the Great Lake don't apply to them... making it impossible to predict their patterns.
无论多么小心谨慎，大湖中的灾难总是无可避免……它们突如其来，又不按常理出牌。

And now's the time to row your way into the ruins the Calamity left behind.
现在……是时候荡起桨来，进入那灾难遗留的废墟地狱了。

Take the skiff to the Lobotomy Corp. Branch. It's on the Lake adjacent to this one.
脑叶公司支部就坐落在邻近的湖里，就乘小船去吧。

I'll be keeping my distance and watching from this Lake, just in case of an emergency.
以防万一，我就呆在这个湖里和你们保持一定距离。

<Isn't that exactly why you should be coming with us?>
<以防万一，我们更应该一起去不是吗？>

Who knows what the guide bud's thinking, eh?
谁知道那家伙心里在想什么。

After a quick tinkering from Faust, the skiff tied to the side of Mephistopheles began its slow descent.
浮士德简单操作了一下，绑在梅菲斯托费勒斯旁边的小船缓缓下降。

It's the same skiff we used to get to the cruise ship.
这是那艘我们登上前往举办宴会的游轮的小船。

We're getting a lot of use out of this boat.
总觉得我们经常用这艘小船呢。
dataList.place:
Mephistopheles' Skiff
梅菲斯托费勒斯 小船

dataList.content:
Mm, I still don't trust this dinghy... It's too small.
太小了……我刚刚也说过，它看上去不大可靠。

The small engine on the skiff revved gently, and our short, sputtering journey to the Lobotomy Corp. Branch began.
发出嘎吱嘎吱声的小船伴随着小小的引擎声，拨开水面驶向脑叶公司支部。

Are Lakes usually this foggy? The Lake earlier was pretty misty, too...
大湖上经常起雾吗？刚刚那片湖域也是……

Mm, we must remain vigilant! Fogged up horizons are climate quite ripe for an ambush! Forsooth, 'tis the number one rule of adventuring tales!
呼，值得注意！雾中突然出现奇物乃是冒险的必备环节！

There was a growing sense of trepidation among the Sinners...
走上被白色覆盖的台阶，前往支部时……
dataList.place:
Abandoned Lobotomy Corp. Drilling Ship
脑叶公司支部钻井船 某处

dataList.content:
... as we climbed the pale membrane-enveloped stairs leading up to the Lobotomy Corp. Branch.
能感觉到罪人间不安的气息和视线。

Hey, Dante? Can you... sense it? The Golden Bough?
怎么样。但丁？能感觉到吗……金枝？

<Not yet...>
<还没有……>

Hmm... You sure about that?
嗯……你确定？

Rodya was visibly disappointed. Maybe she was half-hoping that I'd tell her that the Golden Bough wasn't here, so we should turn around and head right back to Mephistopheles.
罗佳像是期待着我说出这里有金枝一样，明显表现出失望。

Ugh, I know I'm the worry wart of the team whenever we gotta check out places like this, but... I have a real bad feeling about this, guys...
呼……虽然我可能每次来这种地方都会大惊小怪……但是这次是以往感觉最糟的一次……

The closer we got to the entrance, the more reluctant the Sinners's gaits became.
到达支部入口时，罪人们的步伐一下子就放慢了。

As though they were growing increasingly wary that some unseen enemy could ambush them at any second.
好像在警惕未知的什么。

What's the holdup? Aren't you coming?
你们在做什么？不走吗？

Don't you feel it? This dread... I thought it would affect you most. You're the one who spent years on the Lake, after all.
你……没事吗？我们感受到的这种感觉……像你这样在大湖待惯了的人不应该反应更加强烈吗？

So? That's what's stopping you?
所以呢，不走吗？

It's... Haah...
嗯，哈……

Wait by the entrance if you're not going.
不想往前走的人就呆在这里好了。

What did you expect, mate? I've given up talking sense into her a while ago.
大叔，那家伙从老早之前就没法沟通了，你还在期待什么？

I thought she'd gotten a bit more cooperative as of late. ... Guess I was wrong.
我还以为她稍微合群了一点……看样子是我误会了。

Well... We do have to go.
嗯……我们得走了。

Ishmael appeared to be the only Sinner uninterested in the Golden Bough.
看样子以实玛利是唯一一个对金枝不感兴趣的罪人。

The Golden Bough, the unfathomable, bone-chilling horrors of the Lake...
在抑或不在，前方深不可测的未知恐惧足以让每个人不寒而栗。

I was starting to believe that she considered all of that nothing but obstacles between her and her mission.
我想，对以实玛利而言，那似乎只是通向目标的路上会遇到的又一件事情。

What may be this pale, mucous membrane covering the entirety of this structure?
这覆盖着整栋建筑的苍白黏膜，应为何物？

Some kind of mold... Maybe?
霉菌吗……是那种东西吧？

I.F.
懂·自·懂。

To identify it as fungi would require it to exhibit characteristics unlike the ones we can observe here...
要被定义为真菌的话，还应该具有一些其他特征才是……

Hm. I agree. They don't appear to be fungi. In fact...
嗯。依我所见，它们看上去也不像是真菌。不如说……

They appear to be made of organic, living flesh tissue. See the blood vessels here. They've grown into random shapes without purpose or intent.
它们似乎是由有机的生物组织构成的。那些血管随机分布，杂乱无章。

Ridiculous. I am surrounded by I.F.
荒唐。为什么这么多想着懂·自·懂的人？

What do you mean?
你想表达什么？

Art reliant on the chaos of existence cannot create patterns such as these.
依赖混乱而存在并绽放的艺术，没有规律可循。

Look at the big picture, fool.
眼光放长远点，白痴。

Gazing upon the big picture, I only see a pointless disputation that does naught but wastes our vigor.
综合考虑，无谓的争论毫无意义，没必要因此浪费我们的精力。

You do not intend to stall, no? See thither. Ishmael already walks at a fair distance away from us.
你未曾打算停下来吧。看啊，以实玛利女士已经走了那么远了。
